answer: A payout is split thus 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The sable schedule is applied in velvet and mesa makes public each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1429 identities would post 532 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
